Court Orders Maruti Suzuki to Replace Car Damaged by E20 Petrol

A consumer commission has ordered Maruti Suzuki to provide a new car to a customer whose Grand Vitara's engine was allegedly damaged by E20 petrol. The ruling highlights concerns about the compatibility of new fuel blends with existing vehicle engines. This case could set a precedent for future consumer disputes involving fuel-related vehicle damage.
